oceania.headline: Rare tornado whips through small Australian town
oceania.summary: The twister was caught on camera in Ulladulla, New South Wales, damaging property and downing trees.

oceania.headline: Why are these endangered moths swarming Australia's east coast?
oceania.summary: The sudden influx of Bogong moths has caused a stir in cities like Sydney and Canberra, with people filming them infiltrating their homes and cars.

oceania.headline: Parker-Hulme murder: Pauline Parker dies in Scotland
oceania.summary: Pauline Parker, one of the teen killers behind one of New Zealand's most infamous murders has died in the Scottish Orkney islands.
